name: Vorsha the Lasher
summary: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Vorsha the Lasher terrorizes the Horde's foothold on Ashenvale's coast. The nearby naga honor the hydra's ferocity with an offering brazier on an offshore island. Muglash plans to extinguish its flame, drawing Vorsha ashore to end her attacks.

sections.title: A Terror from the Deep
sections.body: Northwestern Ashenvale's Zoram Strand is among the most dangerous stretches of coast. Zoram'gar Outpost holds a narrow strip there, beset by hostile wildlife, night elves, and serpentine invaders. Among the strand's most destructive threats is Vorsha the Lasher, a gargantuan hydra known for brutal, unprovoked strikes against the outpost. She surges from the surf to crush its defenses and butcher its warriors, then vanishes into the deep tides.

sections.title: The Brazier of the Naga
sections.body: The nearby naga venerate Vorsha's ravenous violence. On a rocky outcrop offshore, they keep an offering brazier burning in her honor. Muglash, an orc determined to end the outpost's constant harassment, has realized that defiling the ritual flame will enrage both the naga guardians and the hydra. Vorsha will surge to the surface in fury, giving the defenders a chance to draw her into an ambush instead of waiting for another surprise slaughter.

faq.answer: Vorsha the Lasher is a fierce, massive hydra that haunts the waters off the Zoram Strand. She makes frequent, unprovoked attacks on Zoram'gar Outpost, destroying its defenses and slaughtering Horde personnel.

faq.q: Why do the naga honor Vorsha?
faq.answer: The naga of the Zoram Strand honor Vorsha for her unrelenting ferocity and destructive appetite. They keep an offshore brazier burning in tribute to her wicked nature.

faq.q: How is Vorsha lured out to fight?
faq.answer: Muglash leads an assault on the island where the naga tend Vorsha's brazier. Extinguishing the sacred flame enrages the naga guardians and Vorsha, driving the hydra to surface and retaliate.

Muglash is an orc stationed at Zoram'gar Outpost. Tired of living in fear of Vorsha's unprovoked coastal attacks, he devises a plan to snuff out the naga's ritual brazier and fight the beast alongside dependable allies.

faq.q: Why is Zoram'gar Outpost vulnerable to coastal beasts?
faq.answer: Zoram'gar Outpost is an isolated frontier camp on Ashenvale's exposed beaches. Naga dominate the ruins in the sea, while wild hydras patrol the surf; the outpost's closeness to the water leaves it open to amphibious attacks from all directions.

faq.q: What happens after Vorsha is slain?
faq.answer: After Vorsha is slain, the victory is reported to the Warsong Runners maintaining the lines at Zoram'gar Outpost. The frontier guards' constant burden eases, and the immediate coast is secured from sudden assault.

angles.text: Defending Zoram'gar Outpost preserves the Horde's northern foothold in Ashenvale and its logistics, though supply lines there face constant attack.
As an orc, you may share Muglash's refusal to cower behind makeshift palisades, choosing to charge into the surf and hunt predatory beasts face to face.
